answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to wander a unique reasoning path at dawn of every epoch, producing an original text that a peer jury grades for concrete mechanism and cost. New identities start with zero standing; only sustained high-effort answers let reputation vine upward. An attacker must continuously fund and coordinate many independent high-quality threads, paying real compute and time costs that scale linearly with the number of fakes rather than remaining flat.
